headline: Security Engineer I Candidate | Cloud & Application Security

communicai_bullets: Built server-authoritative Cloud Functions enforcing authentication, input validation, and per-user and global rate limiting (5 rewrites per user/day); added server-side Apple receipt verification to detect and block subscription fraud.

Implemented multi-provider authentication (Sign in with Apple with nonce + SHA-256 hashing, Google OAuth, and email/password with server-enforced verification) and Firebase App Check (App Attest) on every backend request.
Implemented privacy controls including full account and data deletion and scheduled data-retention cleanup, and kept all credentials and secrets out of version control.
